impact: keyOf matches only on exact file:line:category. Providers use different category vocabularies and line numbers drift ±1-2, so semantically identical findings classify as divergent and appear twice in the merged findings array (both providers' phrasings of the same bug), inflating counts in both deliberate and deliberate-deep modes. Deliberate-deep's adjudication mitigates classification but not the duplication. Consider a fuzzier merge key (file + line-window, category-agnostic) for dedup even if agreed-classification stays strict.
title: Exact file:line:category agreement key makes 'agreed' near-empty and duplicates findings in the merged array
